segments.line: You rolled out of bed, hit the floor, and
instead of a thump, you heard a sound. Ding.
By lunch, you've figured out the rules.
Rule one. Nothing really hurts you.
A hit just takes a chunk off the bar.
Sit still for a minute, and the bar fills back up.
You test it the scientific way. You fall off a chair on purpose, three times. Three dings.
Then you sit still and count. Fifty- eight seconds later, the bar is full again.
Rule three. If the bar ever hits zero,
and you wake up in the nearest hospital. Perfectly fine.
And rule four, which Mo makes up on the spot.
